description: Second export from the experiment server: the matched label-propagation audit, Phase 4 (confirmation on unused data and descriptive studies), Phase 5 (improvement loop) with Phase 6 (DINOv3 swap), Phase 7 (additional experiments), and the files of the original server directory that the first export does not contain or that changed after it (R5 round 2, the Phase 3 final test, and the decision records, metrics and run logs of the four earlier evaluations on the test split). Every file listed under 'files' was exported byte-identical to the server file; its sha256 was computed on the server and re-checked after transfer. An anonymized export of this archive rewrites names, hashes and sizes as described in provenance/anonymized_export.json, a file that exists only in such an export.
packages_note: The experiments ran in a shared virtual environment. 79 further packages that the experiment code does not import and 1 editable install of an unrelated project are not listed.

files_note: server_mtime_utc is the modification time of the file on the server (clock in UTC), read at export. It is file-system metadata, not a cryptographic timestamp; the order of decisions is additionally fixed by the hashes that later records quote.
legacy_note: Modification times on the server of the files of experiments/legacy (first export) that were still byte-identical on the server at this export.
